name: greenm-webflow-publish
description: End-to-end Webflow publishing for GreenM. Two skills: webflow-publish (blog posts) and case-study-publish (case studies). Case studies are runtime-aware and can generate missing images with Krea (hero/OG/section), save them to imgs/, and auto-upload (native Data API under Claude Code; Krea upload-URL bridge under Cowork). Includes AEO rationale and the Webflow Rich Text sanitization fix.
